chronos_covariates.note: Chronos-2 can take covariate dicts. PR #10 and this diagnostic do not add them. That is a recorded limitation, not a retune target.

exp_logw_input_logged_back.note: Diagnostic only. Not used to replace the official LOGW encoding.

encoder_time.note: Chronos-2 is given the observed LOGW sequence in visit order. DAY values are used only to align scored rows, not as the time index.
